coverage_meaning: Semantic mapping and test plan; not runtime/visual acceptance

requirements.title: Requirement vs Action
requirements.behavior: Create Requirement with no Action; link zero/multiple Actions; create basic Decision/Finding/Risk context without converting types.

requirements.title: Milestones
requirements.behavior: OWNER declares required Requirements with reason; evaluate each failed prerequisite; undefined required set stays UNASSESSED.

requirements.title: Next Action
requirements.behavior: Read visible assigned NOT_STARTED/IN_PROGRESS Actions with dependency READY; critical chain, due ascending/no due last, stable ID; explain exclusions.

requirements.title: Waiting On
requirements.behavior: Record party or condition, waiting reason and internal owner; response resolves relation only through permitted command, never auto-completes proof.

requirements.title: Dependencies and Blocker Logic
requirements.behavior: Inspect each incoming gate and downstream impact; reject self/duplicate/cycle/cross-Matter links; reopen preserves historical completed work.

requirements.title: Evidence Requirements
requirements.behavior: Draft criterion and required components/version/validity; show missing evidence as gap, not empty attachment.

requirements.title: Evidence Verification
requirements.behavior: Submit exact proof; designated non-submitter verifier records rationale; expiry/rejection/dispute/reversal recomputes aggregates.

requirements.title: Event History
requirements.behavior: Read actor, operation, before/after, effective and recorded time, reason and causal reference; corrections append, restricted security logs stay separate.

requirements.title: Matter Control Room
requirements.behavior: Blockers → Next Actions with adjacent Important Decisions → Waiting On → Milestones → Evidence Gaps → Changes; no fabricated score.

requirements.title: My Actions
requirements.behavior: Filter assigned authorized Actions by current actor; separate eligible, waiting and blocked groups; inspect related Requirement and return to queue.

requirements.title: Operational Grid
requirements.behavior: Search/filter/sort/page, choose density, select explicit rows, edit metadata with validation and preserved drafts; no arbitrary state dropdown.

requirements.title: Bulk Editing
requirements.behavior: Preview title, description, assigned internal owner, due date only; per-row atomic change+audit, persistent partial results and failed drafts.

requirements.title: Excel/CSV Import
requirements.behavior: Map type/date/source key/scoped references; preview invalid groups; deduplicate same source/key/content; changed content reconciles; imported verification remains claim.

requirements.title: Excel Export
requirements.behavior: Choose authorized scope/filter/as-of/timezone, include axes/version context; escape formula-leading values; recheck permission at retrieval.

requirements.title: Document Versions
requirements.behavior: Add distinct version; OWNER promotes with expected prior version/reason/impact; current and fixed-version evidence retain distinct semantics; signatures separate.

requirements.title: Regulatory Filing Lifecycle
requirements.behavior: Track canonical stages, guarded package/signatures, exact submitted versions, receipt/outcome separation, repeated cycles and OWNER negative/reopen controls.

requirements.title: External Parties
requirements.behavior: Select same-Matter external party separately from internal accountable owner; external party has no implied account/access.

requirements.title: Simple Roles and Ownership
requirements.behavior: Require active Workspace AND explicit Matter membership; roles and verifier designation separate; assignment never grants access; revoke pending retrieval/writes.

requirements.title: Delta-Based Status Brief
requirements.behavior: Choose t1≤t2; changes (t1,t2] by recorded-time policy separate from outstanding at t2; stable provenance/order; draft export only.

requirements.title: Separate State Dimensions
requirements.behavior: Display execution, verification where applicable, dependency for Requirement/Action, timing and attention with reasons; server owns derived truth.

screens.name: App Shell & Session Navigation
screens.question: Select authorized Matter without exposing inaccessible titles
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: Read: all scoped roles. Workspace OWNER creates Matter/initial owner; Matter OWNER manages members/designations with last-owner guard.

states.loading: Membership loading keeps neutral shell; no Matter name/count until access confirmed.
states.empty: No accessible Matters; Workspace OWNER may create through guarded flow, others request access outside this UI.
states.no_match: List search has no match; clear query, not empty-workspace claim.
states.unavailable: Membership service unavailable: neutral shell and retry.
states.forbidden: Invalidate pending navigation; remove protected content and names, return to authorized Matter list.
states.stale: Membership snapshot stale: suspend writes and refresh rights.
states.conflict: Concurrent membership/last-owner transfer: retain intent, show allowed revision comparison only.
states.partial: Mixed independent memberships shown only from accepted reads; unavailable groups explicitly unknown.
states.recovery: Revalidate session, reopen only authorized scope; no cached grant survives.

screens.name: Executive Control Room
screens.question: What blocks this Matter and who can act?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: Read all scoped roles; changes through dedicated detail commands; Decisions OWNER/EDITOR per basic context permissions.

states.loading: Keep section headings and shape skeletons; no derived values while loading.
states.empty: No exceptions in accepted snapshot; no claim of legal completion.
states.no_match: Filter excludes exceptions: state filter and clear it.
states.unavailable: Failed overview region says unavailable with as-of; Next Actions/readiness never assume empty/READY.
states.forbidden: Remove full Matter view, including counts and causal titles.
states.stale: Show historical as-of and suspend action eligibility claims until fresh.
states.conflict: Open record changed: keep origin and request authorized refresh, no overwrite.
states.partial: One unavailable region leaves other authorized regions labelled with their own freshness.
states.recovery: Refresh failed region; preserve filter, focused chain node and return context.

screens.name: Operational Grid
screens.question: Which record can I safely work on?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: All scoped roles read; EDITOR/OWNER edit metadata; My Actions uses actual assignee identity; Waiting On keeps party and accountable owner.

states.loading: Retain headers/toolbar with row skeletons and aria-busy; selection inactive.
states.empty: Zero typed records; EDITOR/OWNER can create typed record, VIEWER sees explanation.
states.no_match: Zero filtered matches; announce count and reset filters without pretending data was deleted.
states.unavailable: Grid read failed: retain last-good as stale if still authorized; editing unavailable.
states.forbidden: Purge unauthorized rows, drafts and selected IDs; no failure title leak.
states.stale: Keep draft/selection, visibly label source as-of; require current revision before send.
states.conflict: Keep field draft; compare only readable current values; rebase on accepted revision.
states.partial: Independent row results visible; failed rows/drafts remain selected; unknown rows not retried.
states.recovery: Reset filters or reopen retained draft; restore row/cell/focus after navigation.

screens.name: Requirement Detail & Lifecycle Drawer
screens.question: Has the condition been attained and proved?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: EDITOR/OWNER create/edit/attest guarded completion; OWNER cancel/reopen/applicability only; designated independent verifier separately reviews proof.

states.loading: Drawer title skeleton until authorized read; criteria/links load independently.
states.empty: Requirement with zero Actions is valid; unspecified criteria means UNVERIFIED unless explicit applicability decision.
states.no_match: Linked-tab filter empty; reset only that tab.
states.unavailable: Evaluation unavailable stays unknown; cannot attest readiness from cached fields.
states.forbidden: Close detail and clear protected context; safe draft handling under revocation policy.
states.stale: Show criteria/resource revision and as-of; current-version proof may be stale.
states.conflict: Retain draft and permitted before/current/proposed comparison; new guarded command after rebase.
states.partial: Criterion/relations partly unavailable: mark affected claims unknown, retain available evidence context.
states.recovery: Return to origin Grid/Control Room/tab; readable reason for prohibited completion.

screens.name: Action Detail & Assignment Drawer
screens.question: What work is allowed next?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: EDITOR/OWNER edit/assign/start/wait/complete under guards; OWNER cancel/reopen. Assignee is not the only permitted editor.

states.loading: Header, assignment and causal reason placeholders; no inferred eligibility.
states.empty: No linked Requirement is not proof of completion; require explicit scoped relationship when needed.
states.no_match: History/filter empty remains local to tab.
states.unavailable: Dependency result unavailable; start/complete disabled with readable reason.
states.forbidden: Remove protected record and revoke pending commands; show generic access loss.
states.stale: Keep draft, disable send pending current permission/revision.
states.conflict: Rebase metadata or allowed transition after authorized current read.
states.partial: Metadata success independent of failed transition is explicit; never combine into one success.
states.recovery: Return to My Actions/Waiting On with actor/filter/row preserved.

screens.name: Dependency Graph & Impact Inspector
screens.question: Why is this target blocked and what follows?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: All scoped roles inspect; EDITOR/OWNER ordinary edges; OWNER milestone required set with reason.

states.loading: Label edge table columns while reading graph.
states.empty: No incoming edges means READY only from successful authoritative evaluation.
states.no_match: No matching path under filter; preserve graph context, allow reset.
states.forbidden: Redact inaccessible graph targets and all derived counts.
states.stale: Stale graph cannot accept edits until revalidated.
states.conflict: Cycle/concurrent edge change rejects whole command, returns only authorized path.
states.partial: One relation page unavailable marks graph incomplete; do not imply full impact census.
states.recovery: Accessible edge list is equivalent to diagram; return to originating record/gate.

screens.name: Evidence Submission & Verification Drawer
screens.question: Does exact proof meet this criterion independently?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: Read all scoped roles; submit EDITOR/OWNER; accept/reject/resolve dispute only designated independent EDITOR/OWNER; OWNER alone insufficient.

states.empty: Missing proof: criterion remains visible, no fabricated EV-04.
states.no_match: No matching supplied proofs; reset proof filter without clearing criterion.
states.unavailable: File or validity unavailable: do not accept; retain criterion and allowed next step.
states.forbidden: Clear protected bytes/metadata/draft and pending review; generic access-loss recovery.
states.stale: Criterion/version/reviewer designation changed: retain rationale in authorized context, refetch.
states.conflict: No force accept; compare authorized current revision, re-evaluate exact proof.
states.partial: Some mandatory components accepted: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED, list missing components.
states.recovery: Submitter can submit replacement; designated non-submitter reviews; no independent verifier means pending.

screens.name: Document Version & Signature History
screens.question: Which exact version does this observation concern?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: Scoped read all; add version EDITOR/OWNER; promote OWNER only; signature observation separately guarded.

states.loading: Version list skeleton; no current default guessed.
states.empty: No versions: add allowed version, no proof claim.
states.no_match: Version filter has no match; clear it.
states.unavailable: Bytes unavailable differs from missing metadata; do not substitute current bytes.
states.forbidden: Recheck every retrieval; remove URLs/metadata after revocation.
states.stale: Expected prior authoritative version changed; promotion suspended.
states.conflict: OWNER promotion rebases explicit impact/reason on current prior version.
states.partial: Upload pending/unknown does not promote; partial signature observation does not verify all criteria.
states.recovery: Inspect historical fixed version; current-version criteria may need new independent review.

screens.name: Regulatory Filing Tracker & Package Manager
screens.question: What has the authority actually acknowledged or decided?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: EDITOR/OWNER stage observations under package guards; OWNER negative controls/reopen; independent verifier proof review separately.

states.empty: No filing yet: create typed scope/package when allowed; no submission implied.
states.no_match: No matching cycle/reference: reset filter, retain all history.
states.unavailable: Package or authority observation unavailable: disable next stage with persistent reason.
states.forbidden: Remove submitted-package metadata/links, revoke pending stage update.
states.stale: Package version changed since preview; recheck guards before recording observation.
states.conflict: Retain observation draft and exact versions; OWNER correction appends attributed event.
states.partial: Receipt without outcome remains Authority Review/WAITING with partial proof.
states.recovery: OWNER rejection/withdrawal/correction/reopen preserves cycles; no automatic requirement to reissue authority decision under ARCH-Q5.

screens.name: Bulk Metadata Editor & Preview Modal
screens.question: Exactly which fields and records will change?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: EDITOR/OWNER only; title, description, assigned internal owner, due date. No type/links/waiting/state/criteria/roles/verification/promotion/delete.

states.loading: Load exact selected IDs/current permitted values for preview, not all-match inference.
states.empty: Nothing selected: return to Grid; never target all records implicitly.
states.no_match: Selected IDs hidden by filter remain explicitly listed and require confirmation; no hidden rows added.
states.unavailable: Preview validation unavailable: keep draft and selection, do not send.
states.forbidden: Recheck each row and redact inaccessible values; retain permitted failure identity only.
states.stale: Accepted row revision differs: re-preview that row.
states.conflict: No overwrite; current-readable comparison/rebase; new command when accepted contract allows.
states.partial: Persistent succeeded/failed/unknown results; success deselects, failed drafts remain; unknown reconciliation before retry.
states.recovery: Unchanged separate from clear; only description/due can propose clear subject to adopted validation; title/active owner cannot be empty.

screens.name: Structured Import Wizard
screens.question: Which import groups are valid and what will be created?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: EDITOR/OWNER only; no imported role grants or authoritative VERIFIED labels.

states.loading: Read/parse/validate stages labelled; no imported count until result known.
states.empty: Empty input is not success; choose source again.
states.no_match: Preview filter has no matching errors/rows; full group scope still explicit.
states.unavailable: Parser unavailable: keep mapping/source identity when safe, do not execute formulas/macros/links.
states.forbidden: Revoke commit and remove protected reference resolutions.
states.stale: Scoped reference revisions changed: revalidate groups.
states.conflict: Same source/key/content deduplicates; changed content requires reconciliation, no fuzzy name merge.
states.partial: Connected invalid group rejected whole; independent valid groups may commit; persistent result per group.
states.recovery: Return failed group drafts; resolve refs then re-preview; unknown outcome reconciles before resend.

screens.name: Delta Status Brief Generator & Viewer
screens.question: What changed in this window, and what remains at t2?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: Scoped OWNER/EDITOR/VIEWER read/export; P0 draft only, no managed issued-report snapshot.

states.loading: Window/provenance headings kept; no generated draft while source incomplete.
states.empty: No changes in (t1,t2] is explicit; outstanding may still exist.
states.no_match: Filtered draft scope empty differs from no changes in all Matter data.
states.unavailable: History/source unavailable: cannot claim complete brief; label incomplete or block export.
states.forbidden: Recheck generation AND retrieval rights; purge protected draft.
states.stale: Source/window/permissions changed: regenerate visibly under new provenance.
states.conflict: Invalid t1>t2 linked error; altered source revision needs fresh draft, not overwrite.
states.partial: Any source gap identified, never output an apparently complete issued report.
states.recovery: t1=t2 excludes events; stable recorded-time ordering with stable tie order; explicit draft.

screens.name: Scoped Event History & Audit Ledger
screens.question: Who changed this and on which evidence?
screens.route_authority: DEPENDENCY_PENDING; old R1 routes not adopted
screens.roles_and_operations: All scoped roles domain history read; no role edits/deletes prior events; security log access separate.

states.loading: Timeline row skeletons with actor/time/reference headings.
states.empty: No domain events in scope/window; denied security events are not invented domain events.
states.no_match: No event matches query; clear query or adjust window.
states.unavailable: History service/page unavailable: missing portion labelled, not zero.
states.forbidden: No restricted audit metadata or inaccessible target title in denial.
states.stale: Show source as-of; refresh appends new accepted history without rewriting old.
states.conflict: Correction appends causal link/reason, no edit of prior event.
states.partial: Paged timeline incomplete until authorized relation traversal completes; counts unavailable if not supplied.
states.recovery: Return origin and exact event anchor; preserve filter/time window; no normal-user delete.

r3_refinements.causal_chain: Expanded from 5 plain buttons to an explanatory diagnostic pipeline: Condition, Cause, Downstream Impact, Accountable Owner, Permitted Next Step.
r3_refinements.proof_context: Structured multi-field proof verification panel: Criterion, Required Version, Submitter vs Designated Verifier (anti-self-review guard), Validity Status, Causal Consequences, Honest Non-Simulated Verification.
r3_refinements.grid_typography: Comfortable (44px) vs Compact (36px) without shrinking body font size (keeps 14px); multiline text wrapping without clipping; monospace IDs/time/code.
r3_refinements.hallmark_rule_34: html, body { overflow-x: clip; } verified to eliminate horizontal scroll leak while preserving position: sticky on table headers and padding focus outlines.
r3_refinements.navigation_return: View origin, filters, search query, sorting, density, selection, and local title drafts preserved across modal open/close cycles; focus restoration on close.
